exitDefinitions.C: Existing ENTRY65_DEX C plan: stop40% before first sale, time30m,75% original at1.5x, remainder2x/trail20%/15m after first sale
exitDefinitions.FIXED: Existing E65_PLAN: full-position stop40%, time60m, take-profit2x

invariants: same frozen dataset for all trials
unchanged safety guards and risk caps
all failed zero and truncated trials retained
no paid providers or new market calls
baseline exact regression before actual trials
independent evaluator review before actual trials

selection.eligibility: All six preset/scenario results complete, nonfailed, and at least one closed position each
rank: minimum netPnl/initial across all six descending
maximum drawdown/initial across all six ascending
selection.selectOnlyIf: minimum netPnl strictly positive and zero unpriced positions in all six results

diagnostics: net realized write-down and modeled costs
accounting price contribution = net + costs, not frictionless rerun
actual entry and final exit delays
